review_runs.mathematical_result: Written proofs of the generic polynomial gcd, the infinite family n=1+p+p^2+p^3 with coefficient-localized residual ideal (p,(T-1)^(p-1)), and a selected-divisor formula for every even n at primes p dividing n-1. Derived exact ramified specialization valuations, CRT prime-ideal realization and the Ennola class-order corollary. The n=820, p=3 order-seven component rules out an overbroad prime-power family simplification. A complete global decomposition for row 156 gives J_156(alpha)=(5,(alpha-1)^4) in every number field of degree at most three, and J_156(theta^4)=(5,4theta-3) of class order 2^r in the explicit Ennola family above 5.
review_runs.computation_scope: Public Magma 2.29-10, explicit seed 1: normalization through even n=250; ten specified prime-power family cases; an independent polynomial recurrence for n=40; all even n=4..1000 and p dividing n-1, 2017 residue-order cases. Additional row-156 exact resultants, reductions, isolated factors and residue-field identities verified. All three pass markers present. These bounded cross-checks do not prove infinite statements, novelty or the imported class-order theorem.
review_runs.novelty_assessment: ARS guidance, Sider Scholar/OpenAlex, Google Scholar fallback and primary-source comparison. Unrestricted Gaussian ideal principality, cyclotomic pair ideals and carry formulas are known. No inspected theorem directly states the selected-divisor classification, but priority is unverified; the infinite family alone is a short deduction and the class-group consequences import existing results.
